# Active work — pixelkit

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## Unparented

### Measured exact SIMD coverage in raster kernels

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.raster-simd-coverage/1`

Keep coverage merging bit exact while adding SIMD only where profiles
justify it. The initial u8x32 path handles rows of at least 1024 bytes;
shorter glyph spans retain the scalar loop. Compare scalar and vector
medians for short and long rows on aarch64 and x86_64, then expand to
alpha coverage blending or opaque bitmap rows only after equivalent
output and a measured speed benefit. Preserve clipped tails and portable
behavior on unsupported targets.
